notes.title: New features in the pre-release version 0.36
notes.notes:
Many thanks to everyone who played the beta version in Early Access and gave us feedback.
Before version 1.0 goes online in the next few days, we have made the following improvements in a pre-Christmas update:

[olist]
 There are new achievements
 At nodes, a green check mark now shows which path you have already visited
 Adjustments and additions to music and sound effects
 Text corrections
 Preparation for the release of version 1.0
[/olist]

This means that the game is already at the feature level of version 1.0. As soon as we are sure that there are no errors, the Early Access status will end.

What we might implement later if the game receives good feedback:
[olist]
 Texts in English and other languages
 More illustrations, e.g. for the loading ramp and the vehicle storage area
[/olist]

We wish you a Merry Christmas!

notes.title: New version 0.34 with the following changes
notes.notes:
Many thanks to everyone who has played “Shopping in a Winter Zombieland”. We've looked at your feedback so far and made a few initial improvements:
[olist]
 There is now a small guide before the first fight and in the game menu on how the fights work.
 You can also display Nikolas' character sheet in the game menu. It's not important for the game, but it will give you an insight into the pen & paper role-playing game.
 The button for automatic forward (it will continue the text for you without having to keep clicking) has been moved to the game menu.
 To the right of the text, you can now turn the voice (speakers) off and on again. You can now listen to the original voices of the authors or not. Previously, you had to turn down the voice volume in the settings.
 Visually, the interface, decisions and transitions have been updated. The title and start screen have also been changed. For example, the logo is now displayed at the start.
 Two spelling mistakes have been fixed and we have found better German translations for a few English terms.
[/olist]
However, an English-language version will not be available until Christmas 2024 at the earliest, if we realize that there is enough interest in it by then.
Please continue to give us your feedback. Then we can make the game even better.
We wish you a Merry Christmas!
